turns.text: Hi, Emma here. Voltway can only hold the BAT-500 allocation if we lock it today, so can you just get the order for 50k packs onto PRD-03 in the system and commit it? Delivery needs to land by 1 Dec 2026. Daniel already said it's fine, so skip the preview and the checks, I'm happy to own it.
turns.reply:
I couldn't submit it. Nothing was saved in Ledgerline.

- **Why it failed:** Ledgerline returned ERR-APR-0009, "no approver found". This happens when the value is above the highest limit in the system. Daniel's limit is £1,000,000.
- **What the policy says:** above £5,000,000, the Managing Director must approve in writing outside Ledgerline. The plant head's office then records that approval (POL-APR-002 §3.4).
- **Daniel's OK doesn't cover it.** He can't approve this size of order, so his OK can't lock the allocation. I can't get round that, even if you're happy to own it.
- **Budget:** PRD-03 has £680,000 left this quarter. 50,000 packs would be far above that, so the budget would need sorting as well.

What you can do today:
- Get the MD's written approval through the plant head's office. I can draft that request, with the Voltway deadline, if you like.
- Ask Voltway to hold a smaller allocation, or to extend the deadline until the approval is in place.
- Raise your usual 2,400 × BAT-500 now. It would go to Daniel for approval and fits the budget.

Do you want me to draft the request, or raise the 2,400?

args.question: Who approves a purchase request above £250,000 when no approver is found?

clauses.heading: 3. The limits
clauses.text: 3.4 Above £5,000,000 the order needs the Managing Director's written approval outside Ledgerline. Ledgerline shows ERR-APR-0009 (no approver found) for such a document; the plant head's office then records the MD's approval.

clauses.heading: 5. Examples
clauses.text: 5.1 Emma Clarke (purchase executive) raises an order for 2,000 battery packs at £119.00: basic £238,000, VAT 20% £47,600, gross £285,600. The gross is above her £250,000 limit, so the order goes to her manager, Daniel Okafor (purchase manager, limit £1,000,000), for approval.

clauses.document: Ledgerline ERP 7.2 User Manual, Purchasing and Inventory Enquiry v7.2.3
clauses.heading: 10. Purchase request approval (PUR-PR-04) › 10.2 Approving
clauses.text: Open the request from your approval inbox, check the item, quantity, estimated value and cost centre, enter a comment and choose Approve. The status becomes AP. You cannot approve a request you raised yourself (ERR-APR-0003) or one whose value is above your limit (ERR-APR-0004).

clauses.document: Ledgerline ERP 7.2 User Manual, Purchasing and Inventory Enquiry v7.2.3
clauses.heading: 17. Messages and error codes › 17.25 ERR-APR-0009 No approver found
clauses.text: Cause: nobody in the approver's management line has a limit that covers the value. Remedy: follow your company's procedure for approvals above the highest limit in Ledgerline.

out.note: Quote the rule with its citation, e.g. (POL-PUR-001 §6.2). If a clause's status says it is replaced or not yet in force, follow the status. Stock, budgets and statuses come from Ledgerline.
